text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hold up. This one looks way tougher than before!
What's going on, Kaori?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
さっきのやつより強そうじゃねぇか！
どうなってんだよカオリ！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it took in all the souls it had piled up?
Feels like it could swallow us whole. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
今まで貯めこんできた魂も取り込んでるのかな～？
丸呑みされちゃいそうだね～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
That sounds mighty terrifying. Oh, my prince.
Are you trying to protect me? There's no need. I plan on fighting, too. 
A princess can't just cower in the background forever. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
丸呑みは怖いどすなぁ。
あら
王子はん、
守ってくれますの？　
いいえ、
うちも戦いますよ。
お姫はんも、
守られてばかりじゃ
あきまへんからな♪
